hooks.name: Check AWS docs tool (demo)
hooks.description: Demonstrate a PreToolUse interception without modifying AWS resources.

action.prompt: This is a lab-only demonstration for the pending AWS documentation search tool call. Inspect the pending search input. If its search_phrase contains the exact token HOOK_BLOCK_DEMO, block this tool call, explain that the lab hook intercepted it, and do not use another tool to bypass the block. Otherwise allow the read-only documentation search to proceed.
